children: By Kohei Hayashi / Yomiuri Shimbun Staff Writer

Sony Group Corp. is experiencing success in its entertainment business, and is growing more confident in utilizing its intellectual properties across more fields, according to Chief Financial Officer Lin Tao.

"We have long been investing in the entertainment business, and we have finally reached a point where we are releasing major hits every year," Tao said Thursday, during a press conference announcing the company's financial results for the first half of fiscal 2026. "We are now at a stage where we can make use of our intellectual properties in more diverse ways."
Meanwhile, Sony has seen a drop in sales of image sensors for smartphones, primarily due to a sluggish smartphone market impacted by soaring memory prices, among other reasons.

"We will carefully examine our sales forecast for this fiscal year while monitoring factors such as supply constraints for memory and other components, as well as the impact of price hikes for high-end products on demand," Tao said.
